PredUnresolved is a local two-value enum (NonFiniteInput | ExactRangeOverflow): the evidence algebra's UnresolvedWitness classifies refusals of whole certified operations (RootNotIsolated, KrawczykIndeterminate, ...), none of which means 'this predicate is undecidable'.
